title: PDU EAP message reliable transport procedure initiation

entities.name: PDU EAP message reliable transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure for reliable transport of EAP messages between SMF and UE during PDU session authentication

entities.name: PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: NAS message sent by SMF to initiate PDU session authentication with EAP message transport

entities.name: PTI IE
entities.description: Procedure Transaction Identity information element set to 'No procedure transaction identity assigned'

entities.name: EAP message IE
entities.description: Information element containing the EAP-request message provided by DN or generated locally

entities.name: Remote UE handling information IE
entities.description: Information element containing remote user identity if received in Remote UE context connected IE

entities.name: Timer T3590
entities.description: Timer started by SMF when sending PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message

entities.name: Timer T3396
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon receipt of PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message, associated with DNN

entities.name: Timer T3584
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon receipt of PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message, associated with S-NSSAI and DNN combinations

entities.name: Timer T3585
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon receipt of PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message, associated with S-NSSAI

entities.name: DNN provided condition
entities.description: Condition where UE provided a DNN during PDU session establishment

entities.name: S-NSSAI provided condition
entities.description: Condition where UE provided an S-NSSAI during PDU session establishment

entities.name: EAP message passed to upper layers
entities.description: UE passes EAP message received in EAP message IE to upper layers using NAS transport procedure

relations.description: Procedure initiation involves creating and sending PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message
Message contains PTI IE set to 'No procedure transaction identity assigned'
Message contains EAP message IE with EAP-request message
Message may contain Remote UE handling information IE
SMF starts timer T3590 when sending PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message
UE stops timer T3396 upon receipt of PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message
UE stops timer T3584 upon receipt of PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message
UE stops timer T3585 upon receipt of PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message
Timer T3396 stopping is conditional on whether DNN was provided during PDU session establishment
Timer T3585 stopping is conditional on whether S-NSSAI was provided during PDU session establishment
Receipt of message establishes that UE passes EAP message to upper layers
